text: Electrical engineering is an engineering discipline centered around the generation, transmission, distribution, application of electrical energy, and the research and development of related equipment. From the charging of mobile phones and household circuits to the dispatch of power grids, the traction of high-speed trains, and the power supply of satellites, all these are inseparably linked to the technical applications of electrical engineering. It is the "nerve center" of modern industry and also a core force driving the development of fields such as new energy and intelligent manufacturing.
